correctness.rationale: Comparing two outputs with starts i<j, the middle coordinates are W[t] versus W[t+b] for i<=t<j and all others match automatically. Thus equality classes of start sites are intervals and S=1+L-sum(E_i), with L=n-b and E_i the lag-b return. Uniform proper words are exactly a uniform initial symbol with independent uniform nonzero additive increments modulo q, including composite q. For 0<d<b the joint return probability is the sum over a conditioned intermediate symbol a of P^d(x,a)^2 P^(b-d)(a,x), by symmetry of P. With m=q-1, x=r^d and y=r^(b-d), substituting the two eigenmodes into this sum and subtracting p^2 simplifies to m*x^2*(1+(m-1)y-m*y^2)/q^2. Its factors (1-y)(1+m*y) give zero for b-d=1 and positivity for b-d>=2. Disjoint increment windows give independence for d>=b. Counting available pairs gives the stated finite variance, including L=1 and positivity of adjacent covariance whenever such pairs exist for b>=3. At b=2, conditional on all increments up through U_i, exactly one of the q-1 values of U_(i+1) yields a return, making the full sequence of return indicators IID by induction, not merely uncorrelated. The fixed-parameter CLT follows by independent length-floor(L^(1/3)) blocks separated by b indices. The omitted indices including the final remainder have centered variance O_b(L^(2/3)); Cauchy–Schwarz compares retained and full variances, and every centered block is o(sqrt(L)), so Lindeberg applies with the positive displayed variance. Since L/n tends to 1, the normalization is as stated. The uploaded small-strata checker was inspected as text, not executed, and is not used as the proof.

value.rationale: Exact uncertainty of the number of distinct outputs is meaningful even when the deterministic collision identity and expected size are known. The covariance calculation shows exactly when the independent-trials variance fails and by how much for every finite length, while the b=2 exception is a genuine full-law simplification. The fixed-b Gaussian variance quantifies the same effect at scale. This is a motivated constrained-input benchmark, not a deletion-code capacity or large-burst claim.
